title: A cusp gives the minimum · Set 3
statement:
Find the absolute minimum value of $3+|2x-[$a]|$ on $[0,6]$.

[__________]{a}
hints: Consider where the absolute value vanishes.
Check that input is in the interval.
The answer is the value, rather than the input.
solution: At $x=[$a]/2$ the absolute value is zero. The minimum is $3$.

feedback.message: The answer is the value, rather than the input.
